story.title: The Second Shadow
story.logline: A woman discovers her shadow is moving half a second before she does, leading to a terrifying realization about who is copying whom.
story.twist: She is not the original human, but the shadow that finally learned how to stand up.
story.ending: Are you sure you are the one holding the pen right now?

scenes.narration: My shadow just raised its coffee cup half a second before I even touched mine.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a gray hoodie sits in a dimly lit minimalist kitchen, staring at her dark silhouette on the white wall.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on the wall silhouette, fast pan to her face

scenes.narration: I froze, my hand hovering in the cold air. The dark silhouette on the wall mirrored the exact hesitation.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a gray hoodie in a dimly lit minimalist kitchen, hand paused mid-air.
scenes.camera: Medium profile shot showing both her and the wall

scenes.narration: Panic tightened my chest as I stepped backward into the hallway. The shadow detached entirely from my heels.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a gray hoodie stepping back in a dim hallway, wall shadow remaining fixed in place.

scenes.narration: It walked toward the kitchen counter, picked up the real ceramic mug, and took a long, quiet sip.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a gray hoodie watching a dark humanoid figure holding a real mug in the lit kitchen.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot peering into the kitchen

scenes.narration: How could a patch of darkness hold physical weight? My legs trembled against the hardwood floor beneath me.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a gray hoodie leaning against a hallway wall, looking down at her trembling hands.
scenes.camera: Low angle looking up at her panicked face

scenes.narration: It turned its head, looking directly at my hiding spot with eyes made of absolute, starless night.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a gray hoodie peeking around a corner at a dark figure with glowing void-like eyes.
scenes.camera: POV shaky cam from her perspective

scenes.narration: You spent twenty-five years copying every single breath I took, it whispered in a voice that sounded like grinding stones.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a gray hoodie staring wide-eyed as the shadow speaks without a mouth.

scenes.narration: I shook my head violently, trying to scream, but no sound came out of my dry, burning throat.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a gray hoodie grabbing her throat, mouth open in a silent scream.

scenes.narration: The shadow smiled, stepping fully into the warm overhead light and casting me back onto the cold floor.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a gray hoodie collapsing to the floor as the dark figure stands upright under the bright light.
scenes.camera: Wide shot of the entire kitchen

scenes.narration: Now I am the stain on the wall, watching the real her walk away into the morning sun.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman's silhouette pinned flat against the kitchen wall while a woman in a gray hoodie walks out the front door into bright daylight.
scenes.camera: Static wide shot from the floor

caption.hook: My shadow moved before I did.
caption.title: The Second Shadow
caption.caption: For weeks, I noticed the half-second delay in the dark. I thought it was just my mind playing tricks—until the day I realized my body was the one desperately trying to keep up. If the reflection is now the master, what does that make you?
